headlines.description: — Bo Nix has insisted throughout the past few months that the right ankle he injured during last season's playoffs is now healthy, even...
headlines.shortLinkText: Bo Nix runs for a 62-yard TD, leads Broncos past the Cardinals for a 30-16 win

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Dan Campbell's latest gamble did not pan out and the Detroit Lions made plays in all three phases — with some yellow flags that went their way — to bail out the aggressive coach.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions beat Packers 20-17 on last-play field goal to bail out Dan Campbell's failed 4th-down gamble

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — This was, especially in the first half, the kind of Rams team many expected to see all along.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matthew Stafford sets Rams TD pass record as Los Angeles rolls past Raiders 35-21

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Frustrated by a two-game skid, the Seattle Seahawks went into playoff mode.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaxon Smith-Njigba has 150 receiving yards and a score in the Seahawks' 20-3 win over the Chiefs

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — Tanner McKee and the Philadelphia Eagles still had a potential victory within their grasp in the fourth quarter when the career backup threw a pass into the outstretched hands of DeMarvion Overshown.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dak Prescott throws 3 TD passes, Javonte Williams runs for 155 yards as Cowboys beat Eagles 38-21

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Jordan Love realizes the Green Bay Packers need to finish better.
headlines.shortLinkText: Love throws 3 TD passes as the Packers beat the Panthers 27-19

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — With Josh Allen at quarterback, anything seems possible for the Buffalo Bills — including overcoming a sloppy first half.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills cruise in 2nd half to 36-10 win over Ravens, who lose QBs Jackson and Huntley to injuries

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — Bengals defensive tackle Dexter Lawrence had some simple advice for Joe Burrow as the franchise quarterback prepared to take the field with Cincinnati trailing the Tennessee Titans by a touchdown in the fourth quarter.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joe Burrow throws 5 TD passes, then runs for score in OT as Bengals rally for 43-36 win over Titans

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — Tyler Allgeier jolted his Arizona offense, which gave Gardner Minshew and Michael Wilson a chance to stun the Dallas Cowboys.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chad Ryland kicks winner after PAT miss that forced OT as Cards beat Cowboys 33-30 with wild rally

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — The Detroit Lions handed the Minnesota Vikings their first loss of the season and had a muted celebration because All-Pro linebacker
headlines.shortLinkText: Goff throws go-ahead touchdown pass to Williams and Lions beat Vikings 19-15 for their 1st loss

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Kirk Cousins got up after his 1-yard touchdown run, crouched near the Raiders' sideline and started flapping his right elbow like a chicken wing.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders rally past the Jets 38-33 as Kirk Cousins leads a comeback to snap a 4-game skid

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — The Pittsburgh Steelers spent all week hearing the chatter coming from Cleveland, then spent all Sunday emphatically and repeatedly putting their longtime rivals in their place.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers bulldoze Browns 27-6 to take AFC North lead, extend home streak over rivals to 23 straight

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Baker Mayfield threw more downfield blocks than he had completions.
headlines.shortLinkText: Buccaneers beat Falcons 16-0 despite failing to complete a single pass in wet, sloppy conditions

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — The Jacksonville Jaguars' latest home blowout gave them a three-game lead in the AFC South — and put them in a spot they haven't been in since 1999.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars deliver big plays on both sides of the ball in 42-7 romp over rebuilding Colts

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — Aaron Donald sprinted after Justin Herbert's loose fumble with almost nothing but open turf between him and his first touchdown for the Los Angeles Rams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matthew Stafford and Rams overcome slow start, rally past winless Chargers 24-9

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — The one thing the Denver Broncos do really well is win close games.
headlines.shortLinkText: On fourth-and-goal, Roach drops Mahomes and flips the AFC West race as Broncos beat Chiefs 28-24

events.name: New England Patriots at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — Drake Maye was without a pair of top receivers and a running back Sunday against the Miami Dolphins.
headlines.shortLinkText: Maye has 3 touchdowns as Patriots rally to beat Dolphins 24-19

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — The Washington Commanders had just under two weeks to sit with their disheartening start to the season before their matchup against the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jayden Daniels throws TD pass and Commanders shut out Eagles over final 3 quarters in 27-10 win

events.name: Chicago Bears at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Jeffery Simmons ran out of the tunnel for the first time since joining the Chicago Bears with a new uniform, orange sleeves and a wide smile as he welcomed the move that put right into contention...
headlines.shortLinkText: Caleb Williams and Jeffery Simmons lead the Bears past the Seahawks 34-17

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — With their top two quarterbacks injured, the Baltimore Ravens were prepared to use any trick necessary in their attempt to keep the game competitive against Jacksonville. That included snapping the ball directly to Derrick Henry on quite a few...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars thrash the depleted Ravens 33-10 for their 5th win in 6 games

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — Joe Burrow threw for three touchdowns and rushed for another and the Cincinnati Bengals' offense kept rolling to defeat the Atlanta Falcons 34-17 in Madrid on Sunday for their fourth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Burrow powers Bengals past the Falcons in Madrid for their 4th straight win

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — With the Dallas Cowboys trailing by three points and on the verge of yet another fourth-quarter collapse, Dak Prescott needed 29 seconds to bail them out.
headlines.shortLinkText: Javonte Williams' late TD run helps Cowboys avoid another 4th-quarter collapse and beat Colts 27-23

events.name: New York Jets at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes walked off the field dangling his right arm, which had been bent grotesquely on a strip-sack by the Jets' David Bailey, and for the briefest of moments a pall seemed to descend over Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kenneth Walker scores 3 TDs as the Chiefs roll past the woeful Jets 35-12 to end their 2-game skid

events.name: Detroit Lions at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — The Detroit Lions have repeated a mantra all week in the aftermath of a scary neck injury to All-Pro linebacker Jack Campbell.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions grind past Dolphins 19-9 as Jahmyr Gibbs scores and Jake Bates makes 4 field goals

events.name: Cleveland Browns at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Saints second-year quarterback Tyler Shough likes to think he has a refined and thoughtful approach to remaining calm and in control in the clutch.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints hold on for a 23-22 overtime victory over the Browns by stopping a 2-point conversion

events.name: New York Giants at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — J.J. McCarthy may as well have been any New York Giants fan nervously watching on TV as the injured quarterback tossed a football to keep warm and paced around the locker room.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston, McCarthy combine to lead Giants to 19-11 win and hand Eagles 7th straight loss

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Washington Commanders

highlights.headline: Rams outlast Commanders with defensive showcase
highlights.description: Rams outlast Commanders with defensive showcase

headlines.description: — There's still room for growth from the star-studded Rams, but they're starting to show again why they were a preseason Super Bowl favorite.
headlines.shortLinkText: Puka Nacua, Myles Garrett lead Rams to 20-13 win over Commanders

events.name: Denver Broncos at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — The Denver Broncos continue to know how to win close games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bo Nix throws for 2 TDs, Broncos win key challenge to beat Panthers 26-21 for fifth straight victory

events.name: Houston Texans at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — C.J. Stroud had been feeling lousy all week, barely practiced and woke up with chills on game day. Then he had his version of Michael Jordan's flu game.
headlines.shortLinkText: C.J. Stroud tosses 5 TD passes as Texans rout winless Chargers 44-22. LA finally scores a TD

events.name: Green Bay Packers at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — If Jordan Love has played a better game than he did on Sunday, he can't remember it.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Love accounts for 4 touchdowns, Packers force 4 turnovers in 45-27 win over Patriots

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — Jaden Dugger set the tone for the second half when he returned an interception from Kirk Cousins on the first play for a touchdown.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers capitalize on 5 2nd-half takeaways to cruise past Raiders 38-17

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — AJ Barner's breakout came just when the Seahawks needed it.
headlines.shortLinkText: AJ Barner has a TD catch and runs for a score in Seahawks' 17-3 win over Cardinals

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Chicago Bears

highlights.description: Bears survive, take down Bucs with walk-off field goal
